title: `cfgtool check` exits 0 even when the config file is invalid
body: Running `cfgtool check bad.ini` prints 'INVALID: ...' to stderr but the process still exits 0, so our CI gate passes on broken configs. An invalid config must exit non-zero (2 is the convention for a validation failure); a valid config keeps exiting 0.
bug: cmd_check prints INVALID but returns 0, and main() always exits with 0.
